subject: maths
question: A hemispherical shell has an inner radius of 12 cm and an outer radius of 13 cm. Calculate the volume of the material forming the shell.
solution:
**Given:**

Inner radius (r₁) = 12 cm

Outer radius (r₂) = 13 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3)πr³

Volume of the shell = Volume of outer hemisphere - Volume of inner hemisphere

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of outer hemisphere = (2/3)π(13)3&
